deployments_detail.use: AI digital employees '海小智' and '海小慧' launched on the mobile banking app / e-channel to handle balance inquiries, transfers, bill payments, wealth-management guidance and product introductions, with a focus on lowering the barrier for elderly users; built on SenseTime's '商量' (SenseNova) LLM and digital-human video generation. [SenseTime (商汤科技) — SenseNova LLM + digital human]

AI mobile banking with 'dialogue-as-service' (对话即服务): customers complete 10+ high-frequency services (transfers, loan repayment, wealth-management consulting, pension management) by text or voice with multi-turn context understanding, shifting from 'people find services' to 'services find people'. Powered by Ant Group's enterprise agent platform Agentar (LUI natural-language interaction, agent development, model management, compute scheduling). [Ant Group / Ant Digital Technologies (蚂蚁数科) — Agentar platform]
deployments_detail.value: Business handling conversion rate improved by 10 percentage points; elderly customer satisfaction significantly improved

deployments_detail.use: First-in-industry Shanghainese-dialect (沪语) voice AI in mobile banking: full-chain dialect interaction (voice wake-up, recognition, comprehension, response) letting elderly Shanghainese speakers do transfers, loan repayment, investment consulting and pension management entirely in dialect; built on a multimodal Shanghainese speech LLM from CaiYue Xingchen / StepFun. [CaiYue Xingchen (财跃星辰) & StepFun (阶跃星辰) — multimodal dialect speech LLM]

Interbank negotiable certificate of deposit (同业存单) AI robot acting as an 'intelligent co-pilot' for traders: integrates AI dialogue, customer-intent recognition and back-office process automation to handle batch quoting, CD price inquiries and subscription reminders (intelligent outreach, assistance, process tracking). [none]
deployments_detail.value: Replaced over 60% of repetitive work; since late-April 2026 launch processed 2,700+ inquiry messages, served 100+ counterparties, assisted raising 100B+ yuan

deployments_detail.use: AI infrastructure / large-model innovation ecosystem: localized (on-prem) deployment of open-source LLM series including DeepSeek and Qwen as the bank's base-model system, using large-and-small-model collaboration for scenarios such as customer marketing; embedded in the bank's 'deepening digital transformation' plan. [DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba) — open-source LLMs, self-hosted]

Strategic launch of China's first large-model system focused on pension/elderly finance and dialect intelligence (智慧养老金融大模型体系), a three-way collaboration to deliver smarter financial services to elderly customers, built on the multimodal 'CaiYue' finance LLM (trained on trillion-scale financial corpora). [CaiYue Xingchen (财跃星辰) & StepFun (阶跃星辰) — CaiYue multimodal finance LLM]

Bank-wide (全行级) AI platform: strengthened AI base capabilities with a compute platform centered on resource sharing and flexible scheduling; using large and small models the bank has self-developed 100+ agents (智能体) across business scenarios. [none]
Self-developed "同业存单AI机器人" (interbank CD robot); 100+ intelligent agents; AI尽调助手 (due-diligence) + 智能问数助手; multi-agent AI mobile banking

Intelligent data-query platform (智能问数平台) letting non-technical staff obtain metrics and insights via natural-language Q&A across corporate and retail banking; built on DigitForce's SwiftAgent agent architecture with a DeepSeek LLM base, using RAG and a semantic layer plus an acceleration engine for sub-second queries. [DigitForce (数势科技) SwiftAgent + DeepSeek]
deployments_detail.value: Target: self-service data usage rate from 35% to 80%; ~30% faster response, 50%+ faster analysis (projected)

deployments_detail.use: Asset-custody operations assistant using an LLM to parse fund transaction files (subscription, redemption, dividend and complex transactions) from many distribution channels with inconsistent formats: full pipeline of file reception, content parsing, key-info extraction, rule-based cleaning and standardized output; recently extended to fund-conversion scenarios. [none]
deployments_detail.value: 80%+ efficiency improvement over manual; ~2,500 files/week processed saving ~40 labor hours weekly (vs ~65 hours manual for ~4,000 transactions)

deployments_detail.use: Retail-credit intelligent anti-fraud knowledge graph: uses graph platform and graph algorithms to build relationship networks that identify fraud rings and at-risk customers missed by traditional rule-based anti-fraud strategies. Won 2nd prize in the Shanghai Financial Innovation Award. [none]
